map.行李箱尺寸规格与航空公司随身/托运行李规定对照: Luggage size specs compared with airline carry-on/checked baggage rules
map.行李箱按三边之和（长 + 宽 + 高）与容量区分：20 寸约 55 × 40 ×: Luggage is distinguished by the sum of three sides (length + width + height) and capacity: 20-inch about 55 × 40 × 20 cm (three-side sum about 115 cm) is carry-on, 24-inch about 65 × 42 × 26 cm needs checking, 28-inch about 76 × 51 × 32 cm, 30-inch about 81 × 55 × 35 cm; carry-on is usually limited to three-side sum not over 115 cm and weight 7 to 10 kg, checked baggage limited to three-side sum not over 158 cm and weight 20 to 32 kg.

map.出行前按航司随身/托运限制选箱：短途选 20 寸随身，长途选 24–28 寸托运: Before traveling, choose luggage by airline carry-on/checked limits: short trips choose 20-inch carry-on, long trips choose 24–28 inch checked.
map.对比不同寸数（18–30 寸）的长宽高与三边和，判断是否超限。: Compare length/width/height and three-side sums of different sizes (18–30 inch) to judge whether limits are exceeded.
map.多人或多段行程时分配行李，避免登机受阻或超重。: When multiple people or multiple legs are involved, distribute luggage to avoid boarding obstruction or overweight.
map.尺寸约 60×41×26cm，三边和=127cm，携带方式=需托运（超过多数航司: Size about 60×41×26 cm, three-side sum = 127 cm, carry method = needs checking (exceeds most airlines' carry-on limit of 55×40×20 cm); suitable for mainstream checking on 7–10 day trips. 20-inch (50×34×24, sum 108) is mostly carry-on; 28-inch (72×50×30, sum 152) must be checked and watch the weight.
map.随身行李尺寸怎么算？: How is carry-on luggage size calculated?
map.航司通常按长+宽+高三边和或单一边长限制，国际常见随身上限约 55×40×20c: Airlines usually limit by length+width+height three-side sum or single side length; the common international carry-on limit is about 55×40×20 cm (sum ≈ 115 cm), and low-cost carriers are stricter. This table gives three-side sums and carry methods for each size; the actual rules are subject to the latest regulations of the airline you fly.
map.寸数和容量怎么对应？: How do size and capacity correspond?
map.寸数指箱体最长边英寸数，18/20/22/24/26/28/30 寸对应不同长宽: Size refers to the longest side of the case in inches; 18/20/22/24/26/28/30 inch correspond to different length/width/height and capacity gradients; the larger the size, the higher the capacity but the easier to exceed weight (checked often limited to 20–23 kg), so choose by both size and weight limits.
